Name: IF - DNS Crops Expansion
Author: Malacay2k11
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]# IF_DNS Crops — Expansion[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][b]**Requires:** Industrialized Farm (Nexus #16059) · SMAPI · Content Patcher · Producer Framework Mod[/b][/color]

---

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## Description[/size][/color][/b]

IF_DNS Crops — Expansion brings genetic crop engineering to your industrialized farm. Using a chain of four specialized machines, you extract DNA samples from harvested crops, refine them into genetic sequences, and inject the resulting modifications directly into seeds — fundamentally changing how those crops grow, produce, and survive.

Every plant in Stardew Valley carries hidden genetic traits. A Blueberry is not just a Blueberry — it is a recovery plant, a yield plant, a plant with deep genetic potential waiting to be unlocked. The art of DNS engineering lies in identifying those traits, isolating them through careful extraction, and amplifying them through a process that takes days, resources, and patience.

This is not a shortcut. It is a late-game system for players who want to push their farm beyond what vanilla mechanics allow.

---

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## Requirements[/size][/color][/b]

[i][color=#cfe2f3]- **Industrialized Farm** (base mod, Nexus #16059) — required for Power Cells, Plastic, Biomass and shop integration
- **SMAPI** 4.0+
- **Content Patcher** 2.0+
- **Producer Framework Mod (PFM)**
- **IF_DNS Crops Patches** (included in download) — required C# companion mod[/color][/i]

**Unlock condition:** Year 2, total earnings of 500,000g. Machines are purchased from Krobus.

---

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]## Machines[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ff7700][b]### DNA Extractor[/b][/color]
Extracts raw DNA samples from harvested crops. Every extraction attempt carries a **40% failure chance**, producing Biomass instead. Successful extractions yield either a Plain DNA Sample or a Typed DNA Sample depending on the plant's genetic traits. Higher fruit quality increases the chance of receiving a Typed sample.

[color=#0000ff][b]**Fuel:**[/b][/color] 1× Power Cell per operation · Processing time: 120 minutes
[color=#ff7700][b]
### DNA Analyzer[/b][/color]
Refines DNA samples into higher-quality tiers. Plain samples require **16 copies** to upgrade one tier; Typed samples only require **12**, reflecting the value of targeted extraction. Also accepts Modified Fruits directly, converting them into Typed Samples with a 90% success rate and yielding 1–3 samples per operation.

[b][color=#0000ff]**Fuel:**[/color][/b] 1× Power Cell · Processing times: 600 / 800 / 1,200 minutes per tier

[b][color=#ff7700]### DNA Sequencer[/color][/b]
Synthesizes a finished injection from refined samples and materials. Every synthesis attempt has an **85% success rate**. The remaining 15% produces a Failed DNA Injection — a dangerous consumable that grants +1 to all skills for 10 minutes but deals -50 Stamina and -22 HP on consumption.

[color=#0000ff][b]**Input:**[/b][/color] 3× Good DNA Sample (Typed) + 9× Good DNA Sample (Plain) + 4× Plastic + 2× Power Cells · Processing time: 1,600 minutes

[color=#ff7700][b]### DNA Infusinator[/b][/color]
Combines a vanilla seed with the desired injection to produce a modified seed. Processing takes approximately 1,000 minutes.

[color=#0000ff][b]**Fuel:**[/b][/color] 1× Power Cell + 1× Injection

[color=#ff7700][b]### Molecular Extractor *(advanced)*[/b][/color]
Unlocked later via Krobus at maximum friendship (Year 2, 750,000g earnings). Processes Modified Fruits into genetic Helices — the building blocks for advanced +1 and +2 injections. Requires 2× Power Cells per operation.

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## Injection Types[/size][/color][/b]

| Injection | Effect |

| GrowSpeed Injection | Crop grows approximately 30% faster |
| GrowStable Injection | Crop survives one additional season beyond its natural season |
| ReGrow Injection | After harvest, the plant resets to 50% growth and regrows |
| GrowMass Injection | Harvest yields 4 fruits per harvest instead of 1 |

[color=#ff7700][b]### Advanced Injections (+1 / +2)[/b][/color]

Crafted in the DNA Infusinator using Helices and a base injection:

| Injection | +1 Effect | +2 Effect |

| GrowSpeed +1/+2 | 50% faster growth | 100% faster growth |
| GrowStable +1/+2 | Survives three seasons | Grows in all four seasons |
| ReGrow +1/+2 | Resets to 65% growth | Resets to 80% growth |
| GrowMass +1/+2 | Yields 5 fruits per harvest | Yields 6 fruits per harvest |

[b][color=#1e84cc]**To craft +1:**[/color][/b] 5× Strong Helix + 1× base Injection + 2× Power Cells + 2× Plastic
[b][color=#1e84cc]**To craft +2:**[/color][/b] 7× Strong Helix + 1× +1 Injection + 2× Power Cells + 2× Plastic

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## Genetic Traits & Sample Types[/size][/color][/b]

Each plant belongs to one or more genetic categories, determining what Typed samples it can yield. Plants with multiple traits can produce any of their corresponding samples — each with its own independent chance per extraction.

| Trait | Sample Type | Plants |

| Short growth cycle (3–6 days) | Growth Rate | Parsnip, Garlic, Kale, Tulip, HotPepper, Radish, Wheat, BokChoy, Eggplant, Potato, Beet |
| Native regrowth | Recovery | GreenBean, Strawberry, CoffeeBean, Tomato, Blueberry, HotPepper, Corn, Hops, Grape, Cranberry, Eggplant, AncientFruit |
| Grows across two seasons | Resilience | CoffeeBean, Corn, Sunflower, Wheat |
| Yields multiple fruits | Yield | Blueberry, CoffeeBean, Cranberry |

[color=#cc4125][b]**Notable multi-trait plants:**[/b][/color]
- **Coffee Bean** — Recovery, Resilience, Yield (3 traits)
- **Blueberry** — Recovery, Yield
- **Corn** — Recovery, Resilience
- **HotPepper / Eggplant** — Growth Rate, Recovery

Plants with no special trait (Cauliflower, Melon, Pumpkin, etc.) still yield Plain samples on successful extractions.

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## The Helix System[/size][/color][/b]

Helices are used to craft advanced +1 and +2 injections. They are extracted from Modified Fruits in the Molecular Extractor.

[b][color=#ff00ff][size=3]**Four Helix tiers:**[/size][/color][/b]

| Tier | Name | Price |

| 0 | Very Damaged Helix | 60g |
| 1 | Damaged Helix | 135g |
| 2 | Simple Helix | 280g |
| 3 | Strong Helix | 600g |

[color=#0000ff][b]**Upgrade path:**[/b][/color] 5× Tier N → 1× Tier N+1 (via Molecular Extractor)

[color=#1e84cc][b]**Extraction chances from Modified Fruits (by quality):**[/b][/color]

| Quality | Very Damaged | Damaged |

| Normal | 90% | 10% |
| Silver | 75% | 25% |
| Gold | 50% | 50% |
| Iridium | 25% | 75% |

| Tier | Plain Sample | Typed Sample |

| 0 | Very Weak DNA Sample | Very Weak DNA Sample (Growth Rate / Recovery / Resilience / Yield) |
| 1 | Weak DNA Sample | Weak DNA Sample (...) |

[color=#0000ff][b]**Upgrade ratios:**[/b][/color] 16× Plain → 1 tier up · 12× Typed → 1 tier up

[color=#0000ff][b]**Prices:**[/b][/color] 40g / 90g / 200g / 500g per tier

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## Modified Crops[/size][/color][/b]

All 33 vanilla crops are available in 4 injection variants, plus +1 and +2 variants for a total of **396 modified seeds**. Modified seeds are visually distinct:

- **Base injection seeds** — DNA Helix background + color-coded syringe icon
- **+1 seeds** — same as above + "+1" label in the upper-left corner
- **+2 seeds** — same as above + "+2" label in the upper-left corner

Each injection type uses a distinct color:
- **GrowMass** — Blue
- **GrowSpeed** — Green
- **GrowStable** — Yellow
- **ReGrow** — Pink/Red

**Modified Fruits** produced from modified plants carry a Helix background + exclamation mark overlay and sell for **20% less** than their vanilla equivalent. Modified Seeds sell for **10% more** (base), **20% more** (+1), or **30% more** (+2) than their vanilla equivalents.

---

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## Biogenic Fertilizer[/size][/color][/b]

A unique ultra-tier fertilizer exclusive to this mod. The only way to exceed Deluxe Fertilizer's effects.

**Base effect (Farming Level 10):** 60% chance of Iridium quality, 40% Gold — Normal quality is impossible.
**Scaling:** For each Farming Level above 10, Iridium chance increases by 2% and Gold decreases by 2%.
**Bonus effect:** Soil stays watered overnight (identical to Deluxe Retaining Soil) — no watering needed.

[color=#0000ff][b]**Recipe unlocked from:**[/b][/color] Sandy (Desert Trader) — only available on **Saturday or Sunday**, **after 21:00**, during a **storm**, and only if the Deluxe Fertilizer recipe has already been learned.

[color=#0000ff][b]**Recipe cost:**[/b][/color] 150× Dragon Tooth

[color=#1e84cc][b]**Crafting ingredients:**[/b][/color] 1× Radioactive Bar + 50× Biomass + 25× Sap

[color=#ff7700][b]## Step-by-Step Progression Guide[/b][/color]

[color=#b6d7a8][b]**Phase 1 — Early Extraction (Year 2)**[/b][/color]

Reach the unlock conditions and purchase the DNA Extractor and DNA Analyzer from Krobus. Begin extracting DNA samples from your best-quality crops. Focus on multi-trait plants like Coffee Bean, Blueberry, and HotPepper to maximize the variety of Typed samples you receive. Upgrade samples through the Analyzer. Even at this stage, Plain samples are useful — save them for the Sequencer.

[color=#b6d7a8][b]**Phase 2 — First Injection (Mid Year 2)**[/b][/color]

Purchase the DNA Sequencer and DNA Infusinator. Aim for your first batch of Good DNA Samples (Typed and Plain). Your first injection will likely be GrowMass or ReGrow — these deliver the most visible impact on farm income. Remember: synthesis has an 85% success rate. Failed injections are worth keeping rather than discarding.

[color=#b6d7a8][b]**Phase 3 — Modified Fruit Loop**[/b][/color]

Once your modified plants are growing, harvest their Modified Fruits. Feed these directly into the DNA Analyzer (90% success, 1–3 Typed samples) rather than using the Extractor on them — this is significantly more efficient. Build up a stockpile of Good Typed samples to sustain continuous injection production.

[color=#b6d7a8][b]**Phase 4 — Advanced Injections (Molecular Extractor)**[/b][/color]

Reach maximum friendship with Krobus and 750,000g in earnings to unlock the Molecular Extractor. Now feed Modified Fruits into the Extractor to obtain Helices. Upgrade them through the five-to-one chain until you have Strong Helices. Combine these with a base injection and materials in the Infusinator to produce +1 injections — and eventually +2.

[color=#b6d7a8][b]**Phase 5 — Optimized Farm**[/b][/color]

A fully optimized DNS farm combines multiple injection types. A GrowStable +2 Ancient Fruit grows year-round. A GrowMass +2 Blueberry with a ReGrow base injection produces 6 fruits per harvest and regrows at 50% growth each time. A GrowSpeed +2 Parsnip can potentially produce two or three harvests per season.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][NEW TO Update 1.1.0][/size][/color]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]What is the Hydro Tower?[/b][/size][/color]
The Hydro Tower is an advanced hydroponic cultivation system that lets you grow up to [b]16 plants simultaneously[/b] in just a 3×3 tile footprint. Unlike normal farm plots, it is completely immune to crows, unaffected by season changes, and can grow any seed type year-round.

[center][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][b]16 seed slots[/b] arranged in a ring – supports all vanilla and modified DNS seeds[/*]
[*][b]Fertilizer slot[/b] – place Basic, Quality, Deluxe or Biogenic Fertilizer to gain Growth Points (max 2500)[/*]
[*][b]Hydration system[/b] – use Retaining Soil (Basic/Quality/Deluxe) or rain (+750/day) to keep plants hydrated[/*]
[*][b]Heat system[/b] – in winter, the tower consumes 8 Heat per day. Keep it warm with Power Cells (+5 Heat each)[/*]
[*][b]Auto-pull from chest[/b] – place a chest next to the tower and it will automatically pull seeds and convert fertilizer/hydration items daily[/*]
[*][b]Auto-deposit[/b] – harvested fruits are automatically deposited into the adjacent chest[/*]
[*][b]Water particle effects[/b] – animated water droplets fall over active seed slots when Hydration is sufficient[/*]
[*][b]EXP & Level system[/b] – the tower gains 1 EXP per harvested fruit and levels up to a maximum of LV 50, unlocking powerful bonuses per level:
[list]
[*][i]+1% chance to upgrade fruit quality by one tier (max 50%)[/i][/*]
[*][i]+0.4% chance for an extra fruit per harvest (max 20%)[/i][/*]
[*][i]+0.2% chance to skip a growth day (max 10%)[/i][/*]
[*][i]+0.5% chance to receive a random DNS Sample on harvest (max 25%)[/i][/*]
[/list][/*][/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=4]Unlock Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Year 2 or later[/*]
[*]Willy's boat repaired (Ginger Island accessible)[/*]
[*]Robin at 6+ hearts[/*]
[/list]

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]## ?? Deutsche Zusammenfassung[/size][/color][/b]

[b][color=#ff00ff][size=3]IF_DNS Crops — Expansion[/size][/color][/b] fügt ein komplettes genetisches Pflanzenzucht-System in deine Industriefarm ein. Mit vier neuen Maschinen extrahierst du DNA-Proben aus geernteten Feldfrüchten, veredelst sie zu genetischen Sequenzen und injizierst die fertige Modifikation direkt in Saatgut — was das Wachstum, den Ertrag oder die Überlebenszeit dieser Pflanzen grundlegend verändert.

**Voraussetzungen:** Industrialized Farm (Hauptmod #16059), SMAPI, Content Patcher, Producer Framework Mod. Verfügbar ab Jahr 2 mit 500.000g Gesamtumsatz über den Krobus-Laden.

**Die vier Injektionstypen:**
- **GrowSpeed** — Pflanze wächst 30% schneller (+1: 50%, +2: 100%)
- **GrowStable** — Pflanze überlebt eine zusätzliche Jahreszeit (+1: drei Jahreszeiten, +2: ganzjährig)
- **ReGrow** — Pflanze wächst nach der Ernte wieder nach (+1: 65%, +2: 80% Rückstellung)
- **GrowMass** — Ernte liefert 4 Früchte statt 1 (+1: 5, +2: 6)

**396 modifizierte Samen** (33 Vanillepflanzen × 4 Injektionen × 3 Stufen) mit farbcodierten Icons. Modifizierte Früchte sind 20% weniger wert, modifiziertes Saatgut ist 10–30% mehr wert als die Vanillevariante.

Das **Helix-System** ermöglicht die Herstellung von +1 und +2 Injektionen über den Molekular Extraktor (erhältlich bei Krobus nach maximaler Freundschaft und 750.000g Umsatz).

Der **Biogene Dünger** übertrifft den Deluxe-Dünger und gibt bei Farminglevel 10 garantiert Gold- oder Iridiumqualität. Rezept erhältlich bei Sandy — nur an Samstagen oder Sonntagen, nach 21 Uhr, bei Gewitter, gegen 150 Drachenzähne.
